Provide analysis to support marketing, growth and service-line decisions. 3. Business Cases and New Business Build bottom-up business cases and financial models for new locations, service lines and expansion projects. Run scenario and sensitivity analysis as directed by the Director of Finance, CFO and Management team. Prepare the analysis and narrative behind Board papers and investment decisions. Lead post-investment reviews to test delivery against the approved case. 4. Planning, Budgeting and Forecasting Support the three-year planning cycle for all My Clinic locations. Support the delivery of the annual operating plan: issue templates, review plans with cost centre managers, consolidate, and iterate with the Director of Finance and CFO to Board sign-off. Maintain a rolling best estimate forecast (BEF) updated with actuals, and lead the quarterly reforecast. 5. Performance Insight and Management Information Provide financial and operational analysis that drives decisions. Produce competitor analysis and benchmarking of key financial metrics. Lead MI requirements and support the build of the data warehouse. 6. Leadership Develop and review the work of the FP&A and Business Analysis team. Undertake other duties as directed by the Director of Finance or CFO. Business partnering and influence: builds credibility with non-finance leaders and can challenge constructively. Communication: explains complex numbers simply, in writing and in the room, internally and with customers. Analytical and modelling skill: strong financial modelling, scenario analysis and high accuracy. Technical grounding: ERP, GL and sub-ledgers, P&L and balance sheet analysis, activity-based costing and profit/cost centre reporting. Leadership: develops people and delivers to tight deadlines.
